historical_R19_boundary.reason: R20B is supplemental recovery under a different post-terminal grading implementation and cannot retroactively rewrite the frozen R19 workflow score.

combined_semantic_evidence.statement: Across the original R19 evidence plus supplemental R20B recovery, every one of the ten genuinely fresh frozen R19 worlds now has independent full-domain semantic confirmation. This combined statement does not alter the historical R19 execution verdict.

scientific_update.exactness: The four previously unscored fresh worlds all match exactly once the frozen terminal DAG is graded by a bit-parallel full-domain evaluator and independently checked against Minisat22 on the original frame.
scientific_update.observer: The old R19 execution timeout was dominated by the scalar post-terminal grading path for these worlds; bit-parallel grading reads the same frozen candidate answers without modifying them.
scientific_update.scaling: Exactness evidence is now stronger than before, but resource totality remains open. In particular W10 requires about 75 seconds of candidate transformation, reaches 314694 temporary nodes, creates 1711244 nodes total, and performs 3371758 restrict calls. No asymptotic polynomial envelope is established.

captain_obvious_method_test.instruction: If the scoreboard is slow, speed up the scoreboard without changing the frozen answers or the historical score.
captain_obvious_method_test.observed: All four supplemental worlds were graded exactly with the same frozen candidate; every one returned MATCH, while R19 remains historically recorded as 6 PASS plus 4 OPEN.

next_gate_requirements: Freeze the R18 candidate and R20B bit-parallel grader before selecting any new test worlds.
Use both a larger fresh natural ladder and an adversarial family chosen before outcomes.
Measure final/maximum DAG nodes, total nodes created, restrict calls, compile time, and exact semantic agreement independently.
Treat any candidate resource wall as OPEN, any full-domain semantic disagreement as a preserved counterexample, and never tune within the scored holdout.
Do not infer a polynomial law from the ten-world exactness record; require a separately preregistered scaling claim and falsifier.
claim_ceiling: R20B establishes supplemental exact semantic confirmation for four previously unscored fresh R19 worlds and yields combined exact confirmation on all ten fresh R19 worlds. It does not establish totality, a global polynomial runtime bound, arbitrary-CNF SAT in P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
